message.content:
Charcoal gray wool-blend blazer, structured shoulder cut, hip-length hem, deep slate color #36454F, heavy woven fabric.
Olive green ribbed knit top, relaxed crew neck fit, mid-thigh length, forest green hue #2F4F2F, soft cotton blend.
Tailored dark denim trousers, straight-leg cut, ankle exposure, classic black color #000000, rigid stretch twill fabric.
Chunky leather loafers, square toe cut, mid-calf height, warm tan shade #C19A6B, smooth full-grain leather material.
Minimalist gold hoop earrings, thin wire cut, earlobe fit, bright metallic yellow #FFD700, polished 14k gold-filled metal.

This ensemble perfectly balances the creative office vibe with professional neatness, using a sophisticated color palette that feels autumnal without being heavy. The structured blazer adds polish to the casual denim and knit top, while the earthy tones like olive and charcoal create a grounded, stylish look suitable for an artistic workspace. Comfortable yet refined, this outfit allows you to move freely through long meetings or creative brainstorming sessions while maintaining a cohesive aesthetic.
